blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than P300 million worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) was seized in two separate anti-drug operations in Cebu City over the weekend, including a 41-kilo haul that authorities described as the largest drug seizure in Central Visayas in the past decade. A total of 45 kilos of suspected shabu, with an estimated street value of P306 million, were confiscated during successive buy-bust operations on Friday, Oct. 9, and Saturday, Oct. 10, according to the region’s Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA-7).
